# RISC OS

Every app in this list that runs on RISC OS. That is 1 apps with 1 for Plex and 1 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Matinee](https://github.com/adyoull/riscos-matinee) - RISC OS app that plays what the machine decodes; the server converts the rest. `Plex` `Jellyfin` · `RISC OS` · `GPL-2.0` `Free`
